lines.name: Azamara
lines.notes: Gratuities, house wines, beers, spirits and soft drinks included. Prime C and Aqualina about $50 each for non-suite guests. Basic Wi-Fi inclusion is disputed between sources.

lines.name: Carnival Cruise Line
lines.notes: CHEERS! $69.95 + 20% pre-cruise; Bottomless Bubbles $11.99 + 20%; Premium (streaming) Wi-Fi $25.50/day pre-cruise. Carnival moves drink and Wi-Fi packages to per-sailing pricing from 2026-12-01. Steakhouse about $52 incl. gratuity.

lines.name: Celebrity Cruises
lines.notes: Classic drinks ~$90 + 20% service (third-party, Sept 2026); Basic Wi-Fi ~$20/day; specialty dinners $58-67 + 20%. Soft-drink package price not found.

lines.name: Crystal
lines.notes: Butler for every guest; drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities included. Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio included with a reservation allotment (1 each up to 11 nights); unlimited for Penthouse guests.

lines.name: Cunard
lines.notes: Beverage Collection about $75-85.50/day depending on voyage length (third-party, 2026); Wi-Fi from $18/day. New 2026 Signature Packages (~$75/day) bundle drinks, Wi-Fi and dining credit; contents vary, not modeled.

lines.name: Disney Cruise Line
lines.notes: Fountain sodas included. No unlimited alcohol package is sold (drinks are bought individually). Recommended gratuities $16/person/night, $27.25 in Concierge. Wi-Fi and Palo/Remy prices not yet sourced.

lines.name: Explora Journeys
lines.notes: Drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining included; Anthology tasting menu is extra. Explora III (July 2026) not yet listed: capacity unconfirmed.

lines.name: Four Seasons Yachts
lines.notes: Priced per suite, hotel style: breakfast, non-alcoholic drinks and gratuities included; lunch, dinner and alcohol are paid a la carte (the line suggests about $250 per person per day). Sources disagree on Wi-Fi. min_age: Not adults-only: children 6 months+ welcome (1 year+ on voyages with 3+ consecutive sea days); under-18s must sail with a guardian (official FAQ).

lines.name: Holland America Line
lines.notes: Signature Beverage Package from $54.95 + 18% (third-party, undated). Wi-Fi $30.99/day per Holland America's blog comparison. Pinnacle Grill about $52 (third-party).

lines.name: Margaritaville at Sea
lines.notes: Gratuities $20 per person per night ($24 in suites) from 1 Feb 2025. Drinks: Ultimate Beverage Chill from $69.99 pppn. Wi-Fi from $19.99 per night per device. Beachcomber joins in 2027 (not added). min_age: Not adults-only: infants must be at least 6 months old on the first day of the cruise; the booking guest must be 18+; supervised kids programmes for ages 3-17 (official FAQ).

lines.name: MSC Cruises
lines.notes: Premium Extra about $85/day pre-cruise incl. 18% service; Alcohol-Free about $30/day. Hotel service charge $17/day ($23 Yacht Club) for US-region bookings made from 2026-05-11 (was $16/$20). Bella/Fantastica/Aurea fare 'experiences' are not modeled as separate tiers.

lines.name: Norwegian Cruise Line
lines.notes: Most fares include Free at Sea (open bar, Wi-Fi, specialty meals); the drinks service charge is $28.50/person/day. Standalone package, Wi-Fi and specialty prices not yet sourced.

lines.name: Oceania Cruises
lines.notes: Fares include gratuities (since 2025), specialty restaurants, Wi-Fi and simply MORE (wine, beer and champagne at lunch and dinner, excursion credit) for the first two guests. Cocktails and spirits outside meals are extra (Prestige Select upgrade). min_age: adults-only (18+) for reservations made from 7 Jan 2026; earlier bookings with under-18s honoured (official release)

lines.name: Paul Gauguin Cruises
lines.notes: One ship in French Polynesia. Gratuities for cabin, dining and bar staff, select wines, spirits, beer, soft drinks and Wi-Fi are included. min_age: Children welcome from 1 year (ship cannot accommodate under-1s; may limit under-3s). Under-21s must sail with an adult 21+ (official FAQ).

lines.name: Princess Cruises
lines.notes: Standalone Plus Beverage Package reported at $64.99/day incl. service charge (another source says $77.99). MedallionNet $24.99/day. Crown Grill about $55 + 20%.

lines.name: Regent Seven Seas Cruises
lines.notes: All-inclusive: drinks, Wi-Fi, specialty dining, gratuities and unlimited shore excursions are in the fare.

lines.name: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
lines.notes: Drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities and most dining included; signature restaurants or tasting menus may be extra (sources disagree).

lines.name: Royal Caribbean
lines.notes: Deluxe Beverage Package is priced per sailing (~$56-105 + 18% in 2026 reports); midpoint used. VOOM $16.99-30.99/device/day (official guide). Specialty: Chops $69.99, Giovanni's $54.99 (2024) + 18%.

lines.name: Seabourn
lines.notes: All-inclusive: drinks (most wines and spirits), Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining are in the fare, so add-on prices are not needed.

lines.name: SeaDream Yacht Club
lines.notes: Two 110-112 guest yachts. All meals and beverages (wine with lunch and dinner) and gratuities included; premium wines and top-shelf spirits extra. Wi-Fi terms not confirmed. min_age: Children welcome from 1 year (no child under 1 at sailing accepted); under-18s must sail with an adult guest over 18 (official FAQ). Not adults-only.

lines.name: Silversea
lines.notes: Butler in every suite; drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities included (spa service charge extra). La Dame carries a surcharge. RCL shareholder credit coverage unconfirmed. Expedition ships out of scope.

lines.name: Viking (ocean)
lines.notes: Adults 18+. Fares include wine and beer with lunch and dinner, Wi-Fi, all restaurants and the LivNordic thermal spa. Silver Spirits all-day package about $27/night. Hotel and dining service charge $20/person/day from 2026-01-01 (discretionary). No shareholder perk found for VIK.

lines.name: Virgin Voyages
lines.notes: Adults 18+. All restaurants, sodas, drip coffee and basic Wi-Fi included. Gratuities unbundled for Sea Terrace and below from 2025-10-07: $20/day prepaid, $22 onboard. Premium fare option adds a $15/day bar tab (not modeled).

lines.name: Windstar Cruises
lines.notes: Small yachts and sail-cruise ships, 148-342 guests. Hotel service charge $16 per guest per day; optional All-In package adds drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities. Star Seeker (delivered Dec 2025) not added yet: guest count unconfirmed. min_age: Not adults-only: children 8+ accepted (Windstar cannot accommodate under-8s on its small yachts); under-21s must share a suite with a parent, guardian or chaperone 21+. Official page blocked automated fetch; wording from a third-party policy page verified against it on 14 Oct 2026.

tiers.name: Ocean View
tiers.notes: max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Club Oceanview staterooms sleep up to 3. sqft_min: third-party: CruiseMapper. Obstructed-view ocean views about 145 sq ft. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper. Porthole and picture-window ocean views about 165-170 sq ft (cruisedeckplans 165). Accessible ocean views (about 255 sq ft) left out as atypical

tiers.name: Veranda (incl. Club Veranda)
tiers.notes: max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Club Veranda and Club Deluxe Veranda staterooms sleep up to 4. sqft_min: third-party: cruisedeckplans.com (173 sq ft plus 43 sq ft veranda); CruiseMapper 175. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper. About 175 sq ft plus 40-60 sq ft veranda (Deluxe VX has the larger veranda, same interior)

tiers.name: Suites
tiers.notes: Specialty restaurants complimentary; unlimited basic Starlink Wi-Fi (1 device per guest) from 2026-04-01. max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Club Continent Suites sleep up to 4; Club Spa Suites 2. sqft_min: third-party: CruiseMapper (Club Continent Suite 230-235 sq ft; cruisedeckplans 232) plus about 60 sq ft veranda. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Club Spa Suite about 310 sq ft plus 75 sq ft veranda. cruisedeckplans also lists Grandview (243) and Panorama (656) suites on Azamara Quest only; their tier is unclear and they are not used

tiers.name: Top suites
tiers.notes: Suite perks plus the Ultimate Beverage Package (premium drinks) from 2026-04-01. max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Club Ocean and Club World Owner's Suites sleep up to 4. sqft_min: third-party: cruisedeckplans.com (Club Ocean Suite 538 sq ft plus 173 veranda); CruiseMapper 540. sqft_max: third-party: cruisedeckplans.com (Club World Owner's Suite 603 sq ft plus 215 veranda); CruiseMapper 600

tiers.name: Interior
tiers.notes: sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper. Largest interiors: Excel-class Premium Interior about 200 sq ft, Carnival Luminosa up to 200; standard interiors 155-185 sq ft fleetwide. Carnival's official page says interiors sleep up to 5 (current max_guests is 4)

tiers.name: Ocean View
tiers.notes: max_guests: Official staterooms page: ocean view sleeps up to 5 (Deluxe Ocean View). Third-party: CruiseMapper lists Deluxe Oceanview Family cabins sleeping 5 on Dream and Vista class

tiers.name: Balcony
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: About 185 sq ft plus a 35-75 sq ft balcony. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Largest balcony cabins: Carnival Splendor aft extended balcony about 275 sq ft (CruiseMapper); Luminosa premium balcony 273 (cruisedeckplans; CruiseMapper gives Luminosa up to 335, not used). Most balconies 185 sq ft. Balcony area excluded. Official page says balconies sleep up to 5 (current max_guests is 4)

tiers.name: Cloud 9 Spa staterooms
tiers.notes: Unlimited thermal suite and thalassotherapy pool, priority spa booking. Sold as interior, ocean view, balcony and suite. Ship list from a truncated source; other ships may also have them. max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper. Cloud 9 interior, ocean view and balcony cabins sleep up to 4; Cloud 9 Spa Suites 2-3. sqft_min: third-party: CruiseMapper. Excel-class Cloud 9 interiors (4S/4T) about 150 sq ft; Luminosa about 155; Dream/Vista class 185. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Largest Cloud 9 Spa Suite about 360 sq ft (Luminosa); Excel class 290; Dream/Vista class 275. CruiseMapper also lists a 475 sq ft 'SV' in Excel-class Cloud 9 rooms, which matches the Excel Presidential Suite and is not used. Balcony area excluded

tiers.name: Family Harbor staterooms
tiers.notes: Family Harbor Lounge with continental breakfast, snacks, games; kids 11 and under dine free at some venues. Size/occupancy: Family Harbor suites sleep 5. sqft_min: third-party: CruiseMapper. Family Harbor interiors (FA) are standard interiors: about 160 sq ft on Excel class, 170 on Vista class. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper. Largest: Excel-class Family Harbor Ocean View Suite about 310 sq ft; Vista-class Family Harbor Suite with cove balcony 275 sq ft plus 65 sq ft balcony

tiers.name: Havana staterooms
tiers.notes: Private Havana pool area. All guests in the cabin must be 12 or older. Havana suites pay the suite gratuity ($19). max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Havana Cabana cabins and Havana Cabana Suites sleep up to 4; Havana balcony cabins 2. All guests must be 12 or older. sqft_min: third-party: CruiseMapper. Havana interiors (HA) are standard interiors: about 160 sq ft on Excel class, 170 on Vista class. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper. Largest: Excel-class Havana Cabana Corner Suite (HU) about 350 sq ft plus 160 sq ft balcony; Vista-class Havana Cabana Suite 260 sq ft. Balcony/patio area excluded

tiers.name: Suites (Junior, Grand, Ocean & Captain's)
tiers.notes: Priority check-in, boarding, luggage delivery, tender and debarkation. Size/occupancy: Ocean Suite about 275 sq ft plus 65 sq ft balcony. max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper; Cruise Critic also describes an eight-berth two-bedroom family suite. Carnival Adventure and Carnival Encounter (ex-P&O Australia) have 2-bedroom family suites (S8) sleeping 8. Elsewhere Captain's Suites sleep 5, matching the official page's 'suites sleep up to 5'. sqft_max: third-party: CruiseMapper, cruisedeckplans.com. Largest: Byron Beach Presidential Suite about 615 sq ft (Adventure/Encounter); Luminosa Grand Vista Suite 599 (cruisedeckplans; CruiseMapper says 570-735); Captain's Suites about 500. Balcony area excluded

tiers.name: Excel suites (Excel class only)
tiers.notes: Unlimited Loft 19 access (secluded top-deck area with pool and cabanas, priority cabana booking), dedicated concierge line, guaranteed specialty dining times. Reported extras: Bottomless Bubbles soda package and laundry; laundry terms unconfirmed. Size/occupancy: Excel suites about 398 sq ft up to the 1,120+ sq ft Presidential Suite (some figures include balcony). max_guests: third-party: CruiseMapper. Excel Suites and Excel Aft Suites sleep up to 5; Excel Corner Suites 4; Excel Presidential Suite 2

tiers.name: Veranda (incl. Infinite Veranda)
tiers.notes: Edge-class Infinite Verandas: 131-184 sq ft plus 42-45 sq ft enclosed balcony area (TPG figures conflict).

tiers.name: Concierge Class
tiers.notes: Veranda layout + dedicated concierge, welcome lunch, priority dining/excursion support. Priority boarding: sources conflict (left unknown).

tiers.name: AquaClass
tiers.notes: Blu restaurant (AquaClass-exclusive), unlimited thermal suite (SEA Thermal Suite on Edge; Persian Garden on Solstice/Millennium), spa concierge. Size range varies by class.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Sky, Aqua Sky, Celebrity & Signature Suites
tiers.notes: Luminae (suite-only restaurant), Retreat Lounge (Michael's Club on Solstice/Eclipse/Reflection), butler, Premium drinks + Premium Wi-Fi. Laundry and unlimited specialty dining start at Royal Suite. Aqua Sky Suites also get thermal suite access. Retreat Sundeck not on Solstice, Eclipse, Reflection, Constellation, Infinity. Size/occupancy: Celebrity Suites sleep 4; AquaSky Suites 2.
